propositions: caused_by edges lack a provenance marker distinguishing blame-derived guesses from explicitly supplied attributions, preventing escape-rate consumers from weighting proven attributions differently than guessed ones
caused_by LINK events must carry an optional provenance field with values 'derived' (blame auto-derivation) or 'explicit' (operator/agent-supplied), with old unmarked events reading as unknown
transition_close must mark caused_by edges 'explicit' when a non-empty --caused-by flag is supplied and 'derived' when the culprit comes from blame.derive_caused_by
rebar link caused_by writes must mark edges 'explicit' and the reducer must surface the field present-only without migration
rebar metrics bug_trends must gain a new bug_caused_by_provenance dimension reporting explicit/derived/unknown edge counts for escape-rate consumers
